note: Approximation of the AAMC MCAT content outline (three science sections) for coverage gating. Each content category now carries a `topics` list (the AAMC topics under it) for finer coverage/gap detection; topic ids are <category>.<n>. Category- and topic-level weights are a rough, documented emphasis proxy (integers, normalized at read time) and are TUNABLE (see spec-readiness-score D-SCORE4 / D11). Not an official AAMC weighting.
